questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate. These spaces are posted in parking lots and drivers must obey this regulation.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead. Be prepared to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a curve ahead and recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road will cross a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a shared center lane for left turns. Drivers from both directions may use this lane only to turn left. Do not use it as a regular driving lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overpass ahead. If your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case), do not proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. This sign marks either a school crossing or school zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about upcoming work zones. This sign tells you a construction zone is starting ahead. Drive carefully and watch for construction workers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action shown is prohibited. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a fire station is nearby. Be ready for emergency vehicles on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road ahead has low clearance. Tall vehicles may not fit through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. If you are following this driver, be prepared for them to turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, make space for the incoming vehicles. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left. Drivers in other left turn lanes also must turn left from their respective lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your current direction. If you see this sign, turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign directs you to take a different route because roadwork has changed the normal traffic path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road surface may be slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must drive to the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It alerts drivers that deer may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns you that the road ahead has curves and you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a T-intersection ahead. A road is joining from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. Drivers in that lane must move left to join other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It alerts you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for red or yellow lights and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the traffic pattern has changed due to work ahead. Follow the detour signs to avoid the hazardous area.
